meaning: Static roots whose retention of a stopped server was reproduced on the unmodified native loader with byte-identical mod jars. M34 may cut ONLY these roots' entries for its own stopped servers, and only after measurement has finished; a server that stays reachable afterwards is still a retention review.

roots.why: addCampfire() stores every saved server-side campfire in a static HashSet that only a finished sleep prunes; the block entity keeps its ServerLevel and so the stopped server.
